visible_text: Windows は次の周で追います。
オンボーディングを試作する

answers.q1: They read as grounded, not pure guesses. Each メモ line is tagged with a person's name (Ken, Sarah), a timestamp (10:42, 14:21), and a small 'Ken · 10:42 · 出所 >' link right under the text, and those same name+time pairs reappear verbatim in the 文字起こし panel on the right. That name/time/出所 pattern is the tell — without it I'd assume it was the AI's own summary.
answers.q2: I'd click the '出所' (source) link directly under the item, e.g. under 'macOS を先に出します' — it reads as the built-in 'jump to where this came from' control, cheaper than scanning the transcript list myself.
answers.q3: Yes for the two メモ items — each shows a name and a time (Ken 10:42, Sarah 14:21) and I can match Ken/10:42 to the 10:42 transcript line. The big quote at the top ('Ken Windows は次の周で追います。') also has a name but its time isn't shown next to it there (I have to notice it matches the 10:55 line in the transcript), so that one is slightly harder to place.
answers.q4: I'd click the pencil icon next to a メモ line (visible next to 'macOS を先に出します' and 'オンボーディングを試作する') to edit the text directly. There's also a chevron next to it that presumably expands/collapses or offers more options, but the pencil is the obvious 'fix it' target. I don't see any correction control on the top quote card, on 決まったこと, or on やること — those two are still just placeholder text ('...を待っています') so there's nothing to correct yet.
answers.q5: Moderately uneasy. The メモ section looks trustworthy because it's sourced and attributed, but 決まったこと (decisions) and やること (action items) are both empty placeholders — sharing this now would hand someone a report that looks unfinished, and the unlabeled quote at the top could be misread as an already-agreed decision when it's really just one more transcript line.

weaknesses.what: The purple quote card at top ('Ken Windows は次の周で追います。') sits above and outside the 決まったこと/やること/メモ structure with no label explaining why it's featured or which category it belongs to.
weaknesses.fix: Give it an explicit tag (e.g. '注目の発言' or fold it into whichever section it belongs to) instead of leaving it as an unlabeled floating quote.

weaknesses.what: 決まったこと and やること both show only 'waiting for...' placeholders, so a snapshot shared now looks empty/broken in two of three sections even though the meeting has real content in メモ.
weaknesses.fix: Either hide a section until it has content, or show a lighter 'still listening' state that doesn't read as a missing feature.

weaknesses.what: '出所' is terse — a first-time user has to infer it means 'jump to the transcript quote', it's not self-explanatory as a verification action.
weaknesses.fix: Pair it with a small quote/transcript icon or use a slightly more explicit label so its function is legible without guessing.
